posts.title: AuraCraft Menu Released
posts.message: The first beta of the AuraCraft launcher is now available. This build includes server status checking and the news feed system.

posts.title: Server Update
posts.message: Updated the server to Minecraft 26.2 and improved overall stability.

posts.title: Coming Soon
posts.message: Future launcher versions may include announcements, maintenance alerts, and quick links to Discord.
